title: Seeded verification probability
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let a seed map each $r$-bit string to a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The probability, for a uniformly random seed string, that $C'x=A(Bx)$ coordinatewise on the seeded vector equals the acceptance probability under the density obtained by pushing the uniform seed distribution forward through the seed map.
hypotheses_covered: Matrices A, B, and C' over the two-element field
Seed map from r-bit strings to vectors in F₂ⁿ
